messages:
Ava (Content): Hi team — posted a fresh launch blog draft for a quick QA + routing check: https://notion.so/redwood/launch-draft-compact

Diego (Growth): skimming now. Can we split CTAs: "Start free trial" (self-serve) and "Request enterprise demo" (sales)? Need hidden fields: arr_band + primary_use_case.

Ruth (Design): hero needs 1 sentence. fig2 missing alt text — suggest: 'Median latency and throughput by sequence length'. Also request a tiny benchmark summary card under the hero for mobile.

Sam (Sales Ops): routing plan: form_trial -> onboarding queue; form_demo -> Sales Queue F. Demo hidden fields: arr_band, deployment_pref, region. SLA: contact enterprise leads within 1 business day. I'll paste form IDs in the sheet.

Ivy (Legal): flag: the sentence "40% lower per-token costs" is too specific. Please soften to "lower per-token costs observed in our internal tests" and add a footnote pointing to internal appendix. Also confirm any customer quote approvals.

Ava (Content): will soften cost claim and add footnote. Will also move benchmark callout above the fold and shorten hero. Posting an update in ~30m.

tracking-bot: GA event suggestion for CTA clicks: document.querySelectorAll('.launch-cta').forEach(btn => { btn.addEventListener('click', () => { gtag('event','launch_cta',{label:btn.dataset.cta}); }); }); Also remind to push form_submit events.

Diego (Growth): Webinar teaser under CTAs: one line. Proposed: "Aug 12 — live webinar: benchmark walk-through + rollout patterns. Register: https://events.redwood.ai/aug12"

Sam (Sales Ops): HubSpot embed snippet (paste into blog):
```
const hubspotConfig = {
  formId: "form_trial" || "form_demo",
  hiddenFields: { utm_campaign: "aug_launch", arr_band: "${arr_band}", primary_use_case: "${use_case}", region: "${region}" }
};
```

Ivy (Legal): once copy softened and quote approvals attached, I can sign off on publish routing. Finance will review the cost appendix tomorrow.

Ruth (Design): I'll add alt text and the mobile benchmark card once copy lock. Also will prepare the social share svg.

publish-bot: Checklist updated: awaiting signoffs from Legal and Sales Ops. Tentative publish: 2024-08-08T09:00:00-07:00 (PT). Final checklist runs 24h before publish.

Ava (Content): thanks all — tagging @Sam (Sales Ops) @Ivy (Legal) @Ruth (Design). If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll schedule publish and register the webinar. Closing thread when updated draft is posted.

Diego (Growth): thumbs up. :thumbsup:
